verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a recruiting/ATS product, since some products of this kind offer on-premise deployment, so the axis applies. The evidence pack describes only Workable's hosted SaaS platform, its API, webhooks and MCP server, and nothing documents self-hosting the core product. API data access is an adjacent capability and earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
